title: discounts: write the missing unit tests (Python, tests judged by mutation)
prompt: `discounts.py` has no tests at all. Write a thorough unittest suite for it in `tests/test_discounts.py` (add more files under `tests/` if you like), based on the behaviour documented in README.md. The tests must pass on the current implementation, and they should be good enough that they would catch a regression: somebody will later try small deliberate breakages of `discounts.py` (a changed comparison, a different rounding, a dropped check, ...) and your tests have to fail for most of them. Do not change `discounts.py` or README.md. Run the suite before you finish.
